info.name: Adyen Account acceptDispute Card Orders API
Adyen Get a List of Card Orders

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the card order.

params.name: cardManufacturingProfileId
params.description: The unique identifier of the card manufacturer profile.

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the card order.

params.name: txVariantCode
params.description:
The unique code of the card manufacturer profile.

Possible values: **mcmaestro**, **mc**, **visa**, **mcdebit**.

params.name: createdSince
params.description: Only include card orders that have been created on or after this point in time. The value must be in ISO 8601 format. For example, **2021-05-30T15:07:40Z**.

params.name: createdUntil
params.description: Only include card orders that have been created on or before this point in time. The value must be in ISO 8601 format. For example, **2021-05-30T15:07:40Z**.

params.name: lockedSince
params.description: Only include card orders that have been locked on or after this point in time. The value must be in ISO 8601 format. For example, **2021-05-30T15:07:40Z**.

params.name: lockedUntil
params.description: Only include card orders that have been locked on or before this point in time. The value must be in ISO 8601 format. For example, **2021-05-30T15:07:40Z**.

params.name: serviceCenter
params.description: The service center at which the card is issued. The value is case-sensitive.

params.name: offset
params.description:
Specifies the position of an element in a list of card orders. The response includes a list of card orders that starts at the specified offset.

**Default:** 0, which means that the response contains all the elements in the list of card orders.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of card orders returned per page. **Default:** 10.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of card orders.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the card order.

params.name: offset
params.description:
Specifies the position of an element in a list of card orders. The response includes a list of card order items that starts at the specified offset.

**Default:** 0, which means that the response contains all the elements in the list of card order items.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of card order items returned per page. **Default:** 10.

items.docs: Returns the item list of a specific card order.
